hooks.command: hook="${SOT_COMM_HOME:-$HOME/.sot-comm}/bin/sot-codex-binding-hook.sh"; if [ -n "${SOT_CODEX_THREAD_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "$hook" ] && [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook"; fi; cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
